title: Normalized etale presheaf presentation with conditional scalar transport
statement: For a scheme X, an adic coefficient datum d on A, M in the completed-coefficient derived category, an etale X-chart V and a supplied algebraic tower T [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data], define B_n=ULift(A/d.ideal^(n+1)), its consecutive quotient q_n, and the category of derived B_n-module sheaves on V_et. A presentation comprises derived objects C_n,K_n in these categories, each bounded with finite locally constant cohomology [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant]; inhabited geometric stalks of their canonical Isom sheafifications [def-weil-pbc-derived-local-isomorphism-sheaf]; specified coefficient normalization arrows dC_n,dK_n; maps p_n of their actual etale Isom presheaves satisfying the generator normalization equation [def-weil-pbc-etale-isomorphism-normalization-arrow]; and, for every U over V and W mapping to U, scalar-forgetting realization functors from the fixed-coefficient categories on U_proet to completed-ring modules on the W slice. Supply the coefficient-restriction interchange and level comparisons from the realized C_n,K_n to the model and actual strict tower respectively. Require the two normalization identities identifying the realized normalization arrows with the specified model and actual transitions. Define transport by applying the realization functor to a raw isomorphism and conjugating by these comparisons; prove square preservation from coefficient-interchange naturality and those two identities. This datum has no evaluation on pro-etale sheafification sections and assumes no unconditional evaluated reduction square.
